title.value: AfricaNLP workshop at ICLR2023 - MasakhaNEWS: News Topic Classification for African Languages
title.justification: The title was chosen because it accurately reflects the focus of the paper on the development of the MasakhaNEWS dataset and its application to news topic classification for African languages during the AfricaNLP workshop at ICLR2023.
title.quote: ...In this paper, we develop MasakhaNEWS—a new benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 languages widely spoken in Africa.

extractions.description: This paper discusses the creation and evaluation of MasakhaNEWS, a benchmark dataset for news topic classification covering 16 African languages. It addresses the challenges of data scarcity for African languages in NLP by providing a large-scale dataset and exploring various machine learning models to enhance text classification tasks. The paper evaluates the performance of classical ML models and fine-tuned language models for zero-shot and few-shot learning configurations, highlighting innovations in the application of large language models in underrepresented languages.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on natural language processing (NLP) and the development of datasets for African languages, which does not directly pertain to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes. The paper advances technological capabilities in language processing but does not address environmental or climate issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: African languages are severely under-represented in NLP research due to lack of datasets covering several NLP tasks.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on NLP and dataset development for underrepresented languages without a direct connection to sustainability themes related to climate or ecology. The advancements discussed aim to improve language processing capabilities, not ecological or climate change issues.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we address two problems of lack of evaluation datasets, and lack of extensive evaluation of LLMs for African languages.

primary_sub_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on linguistic data development and machine learning model evaluation, which does not align with any specific sub-category within Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development as defined in the provided classification guidelines.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...we create MasakhaNEWS—a large-scale news topic classification dataset covering 16 typologically-diverse languages widely spoken in Africa including English and French, with the same label categories across all languages.

new_primary_category.justification: The work does not explore a new dimension of climate or ecological sustainable development that is missing in the current classification system, as it primarily focuses on language data and analysis.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There is no basis to create a new sub-category related to the content of this paper within the climate or ecological sustainable development framework, as its core theme does not align with these issues.
